bye_overval_install_need_moderator.classification_evidence: No terminal ground is met: the week-blocked 95% interval does not sit entirely below zero, so wrong_sign_resolved is inadmissible against the frozen one-sided positive direction; no positive control has been shown able to detect an effect of this size, so positive_control_bound is inadmissible. Category 3 by AGENTS.md.
bye_overval_install_need_moderator.description: Difference-in-differences inside the post-2011-CBA bye population (REG 2012-2025, non-push home_cover): the bye-overvaluation home-edge effect for install-need home teams minus the same effect for continuity home teams. Base flag imported verbatim from scripts/bye_overvaluation_screen.py (home off strict >=12-day bye AND opponent not off bye). Moderator = the home team season-opener starting QB differs from the prior season opener starting QB. Predeclared one-sided direction: contrast > 0.
bye_overval_install_need_moderator.notes: Predeclared in docs/era_mechanism_screens_20260901.md section 2.1 BEFORE any effect was computed; proposed unrun in docs/era_magnitude_report.md section 2.1. Season-blocked secondary +0.1855 [-1.0284, +1.3405] P+=0.6298 on 14 blocks. Within-week permutation null (200 draws, NOT zero-centred by design): null mean +0.1235, [-0.7002, +1.0221]; 44 percent of null draws sit at or above the observed +0.1855. Arm magnitudes: install-need -0.2289, no-need -0.4143 (post-2011); pre-2011 control arms -0.3404 and +0.8915 on 35 flagged games - four magnitudes, never averaged across the parent construct era sign flip. DISCLOSED: the predeclared moderator was new QB OR new offensive coordinator; no offensive-coordinator source exists in this repo (measured), so only the QB leg is built - a strictly NARROWER subset that dilutes the contrast toward zero. DISCLOSED OVERLAP: same rows as bye_overval_home_edge_post2011 and a subset of venue_milestone_post_bye_home; correlated, never an independent vote, never sign-test-pooled with them. Mined-window discount: runs on the full history including the mined 2018-2025 seasons. n_flag 87 install-need / 151 no-need. Battery multiplicity uncorrected (3 cells + 1 companion arm).
bye_overval_install_need_moderator.plain_summary: Teams coming off a bye have gotten a bit worse against the spread since the 2011 labour deal cut practice time. This checks whether that penalty is smaller for teams with a new starting quarterback, who have more to install and more to gain from the extra week. It leans that way, but nowhere near enough to act on.
